notes.title: Update 1.0.1.1 - New Buildings & Weapons !!
notes.notes:
[b]Update - 1.0.1.1[/b]

Hello everyone,

A new Update is now Live!!

This update brings new content and some bug fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40334889/65f28457346b3df016423daa853f58f2e8b7e04e.png[/img]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Here's the change log:

[b]New Buildings[/b]:
- Cymbal Monkey: A monkey toy that bangs cymbals to taunt nearby enemies.

- Barbed Wire: Barbed wires will slow and damage enemies who stepped on it.

[b]New Weapons[/b]:
- Shovel: A good Post-Apocalypse weapon that has high Knockback-Power.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]:
- Fixed a problem that sometimes grenades won’t deal damage.
- Fixed a problem that some sound will play at wrong positions.

============================================================

If you find a bug, please let me know, by
post at Discussions in Community Hub, or send an email to : 
imagitgames@gmail.com

I’ll fix it as soon as possible.

Thank you for your support, and hope you enjoy the new Update!

notes.title: Update - 1.0.1.0b
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Version 1.0.1.0b is now Live!

Here's the change log:

Game Changes:
- Added an option to change Target-FrameRate from the settings.
- Added an option to toggle VSync from the settings.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed the problems when Player interact with objects.
- Fixed Resource Pile’s spawn location at “Roof Top”.
- Fixed Resource Pile’s mesh render issue.
- Fixed the problems that Resource Piles won’t show on the Minimap.
- Fixed UI images’s visual issue.
